verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an analytics SaaS that also ships a self-hosted edition, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way for users to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking, either for the product's own telemetry or for excluding one's own visits. The claims of collecting no personal data, needing no consent banner and offering self-hosting describe privacy-by-design, not a user-facing opt-out control.
